purpose: Keep entity memory visible without turning pages into dashboards or silently upgrading weak evidence.
rules: Never render a hypothesis without the visible word 'Hypothesis' or equivalent uncertainty language.
Never render unresolved material as a declarative identity sentence.
A species_trait requires strength repeated/canonical OR explicit source generalization.
A scene_power may remain memorable but must not be displayed as a species-wide power.
A real-person page may show ordinary/documentary capabilities, but creative/project enhancements must be visibly typed as creative or project language.
A created-being page may show imaginative powers directly, while still distinguishing individual, species and one-scene scope.
Titles should retain their title_type when known: self-declared, bestowed, literary, comic, social, documentary or archive shorthand.
Story beats should prefer source_ref links when available; missing source_ref is allowed only when the source is not yet recovered and the beat is marked unresolved/recovery.
Conclusions are archive synthesis, not source quotations. If superseded, preserve the older conclusion in conclusion_history.
Facet strips are context, not navigation. Do not add one button per facet.

suppress: individual gifts unless used as contrast
creative enhancements unless clearly labeled project/creative
